notes: Major = 9 lower-division + 12 upper-division courses, plus the Department Seminar (MUS 43/143) taken every quarter the student is a declared major. All courses except 43/143 and 95G must be taken for a letter grade. Emphasis areas: Composition, Performance, Literature, Technology, Jazz & the Music of the African Diaspora. Verified against department major page and catalog.

buckets.label: Basic Musicianship sequence
buckets.note: Students without prior background may take MUS 1A-1B-1C; those continuing to upper-division theory take MUS 2A-B-C.

buckets.label: Basic Keyboard sequence
buckets.note: MUS 2AK and 2BK required, plus MUS 2CK OR MUS 2JK (jazz emphasis) as the third — 3 courses total.

buckets.label: Performance ensemble (choose 3)
buckets.note: Choose any 3 quarters of ensemble from MUS 95B through 95W (lower-division) or MUS 130/131/133/134 (upper-division). Mixed-division bucket; listed under lower division on the department page.

buckets.label: Department Seminar
buckets.note: MUS 43 (lower) / 143 (upper) must be taken EVERY quarter the student is a declared Music major; not counted toward the 9+12 course totals. May be taken P/NP.

buckets.label: History of Music in Western Culture
Area of Emphasis (choose 3)
buckets.note: Choose 3 courses, from a single emphasis area or mixed. Composition = MUS 103A-B-C; Performance = 3 quarters of MUS 132 or 132V (audition required); Literature = MUS 107-116, 126, 127, 150-153; Technology = MUS 170, 171, 172, 173A/B, 174A/B/C, 175, 176, 177, or PSYC 138; Jazz & African Diaspora = MUS 105, 126, 127, 150, 151, 152, 153.
